result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits, makes cyber/privacy coverage conditional on access to or processing of Customer data, requires statutory workers’ compensation, and provides for certificates on request. However, the one-year post-termination coverage requirement is not called for by the playbook and is an unnecessary additional obligation. The unrelated provisions are substantively preserved, but placing Section 14.10 after renumbered Section 14.11 is a sequencing defect that should be corrected.
